prioritized_defects.description: The broadcast use case is not modeled with the required local-network scope and receiver participation. The diagram has a 'Send broadcast' action, but the receiving side is only a generic 'Receive message' action; there is no explicit representation that other agents in the same local network receive the broadcast message.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R19 requires an agent to send a message to everyone in the same local network, and R20 requires other agents in the same local network to receive it. In the diagram, N12 is labeled 'Send broadcast', but the subsequent flow goes to N8 'Receive message', which is shared with unicast and multicast and is not constrained to the local network. No node or lane explicitly indicates participation of the Local Network or that the recipients are the agents in that network.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Model the broadcast receiver behavior explicitly in the Local Network lane, or otherwise annotate the receive step so it clearly represents 'other agents in the same local network receive message' rather than a generic receive action shared with other communication modes.

final_recommendation: Prioritize D1 in the next repair batch.
